objective: Build a compact responsive Workshop reservations admin page from three role-specific references.

context.task: Inspect workshop capacities and add a session-local reservation
context.device: Desktop and narrow browser, keyboard and pointer

references.role: Brand colors and FIELDNOTES wordmark only
references.observations: Forest #153F3D, lime #D6EE8C, clay #E6A36F, canvas #F7F6EF, muted #526663, border #D8DDD2; wordmark with F icon
references.inspection: Source read and rendered PNG visually inspected; evidence/brand.png

references.observations: 220px sidebar, heading/action block, wide list beside narrower summary
references.inspection: Source read and rendered PNG visually inspected; evidence/layout.png

references.role: Type families, scale, label treatment only
references.observations: Georgia H1 44/1.15 and H2 26/1.25; Arial 17/1.7 body, tracked 13px uppercase labels, bold 16px buttons
references.inspection: Source read and rendered PNG visually inspected; evidence/typography.png

constraints.stack: Standalone semantic HTML/CSS/JS and optional Node24 server; no dependencies, installation, network or backend
constraints.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 A/AA target; limited checks do not establish conformance
constraints.performance: No external resources; field performance and profiling unavailable

uncertainty.statement: Navigation links move to same-page sections and Reservations stays active.
Local summaries last only for the current page session.
uncertainty.consequence: Reload clears additions; disclosed in UI.

tokens.typography: Georgia serif heading / Arial sans body

components.semantics: Native button opens labeled native dialog with required select and input
components.keyboard: Enter opens; Tab and Shift+Tab wrap; Escape closes
components.focus: Autofocus workshop, first invalid field after validation, return to trigger on close
components.recovery: Inline associated errors preserve valid field values

stateOwnership.local: Dialog state, form values and DOM summary list
